headline: I help early-stage companies turn customer insights into revenue and repeatable operations.
lead: Growth operator at Jumbo Homes. Targeting founder's office and growth roles where I own the full customer journey—from pipeline to closed deals.
value: I diagnose where your funnel breaks, talk to customers to understand why, and fix the workflow so your team can close more without working harder.
portraitCaption: Sales pipeline → Customer discovery → Workflow improvement
portraitAlt: Portrait of Vairag Akbari in a black suit

capabilities.problem: Sales pipeline stalls and nobody knows why
capabilities.approach: I map every step from first contact to close, talk to customers who dropped off, and find where the friction actually is—not where we assume it is.
capabilities.evidence: Jumbo Homes: Currently managing property sales end-to-end across multiple zones.

capabilities.problem: Outreach takes too long and follow-ups get missed
capabilities.approach: I automate the prep work so your team spends time on conversations, not admin. Built a Gmail draft generator from lead data using Google Sheets.

capabilities.problem: Customer needs aren't clear from the data
capabilities.approach: I use Jobs to Be Done and direct customer conversations to understand what progress they're trying to make, then prioritize what matters.
capabilities.evidence: Applied JTBD framework to property buyer qualification

capabilities.problem: Projects involve too many teams and unclear ownership
capabilities.approach: I coordinate across supply, marketing, legal, and ops teams. I keep the next action clear and follow up until it's done.
capabilities.evidence: Jumbo Homes: Coordinating supply onboarding, buyer visits, negotiation, legal coordination

capabilities.problem: Agent workflows fail because they skip human judgment
capabilities.approach: I design AI-assisted workflows with approval gates at decision points. Automation handles prep; humans handle judgment.
capabilities.evidence: Listing image workflow design with 3 approval gates (design phase)

work.title: End-to-end property sales across multiple zones
work.description: Supply onboarding, buyer qualification, visit coordination, negotiation, and legal handoff. I identify pipeline bottlenecks and keep deals moving.

work.title: Seller outreach automation (Google Sheets → Gmail)
work.description: Built a workflow that turns lead data into personalized Gmail drafts. Supply team reviews and sends, spending more time on conversations instead of email prep.

work.title: AI-assisted listing image workflow
work.description: Designed a process from raw property photos to listing-ready images with 3 human approval gates. Prompts validated; full implementation not yet built.

work.title: Club President: 5,000+ attendee events
work.description: Led sponsorship outreach, vendor negotiations, and event operations. Managed 100+ core members and volunteers across planning and execution.

toolkit.inPractice: Google Sheets, Excel, Twenty CRM, outreach, negotiation, and workflow design.
toolkit.learning: SQL, deeper Excel analysis, Mixpanel, product analytics, growth funnels, and prioritisation frameworks.
toolkit.interest: Interested in GTM engineering through useful agents and better business workflows.
